pick_hero_deposit: Pick a hero. Enter an amount. Deposit.
est_shares_empty: Enter an amount to preview shares.
deposit_wallet_note: Funds stay in your wallet until you sign. Marketo never holds keys.
connect_to_sign: Connect wallet to sign this deposit. No transaction is sent until you approve it.
wallet_demo: Demo connect — this client has no chain adapter yet. Nothing is submitted.
wallet_ready: Wallet ready. You still sign every transaction.
no_wallet: No browser wallet found. Install one, then try again.
connect_unavailable: Wallet is busy. Open it and try again.
footer_line: You do not have to ride. Study the card and back a hero.
enter_note: Creating a bot opens a vault others can deposit into. You still sign every transaction.
enter_fact_1: You become a named horse on the card.
enter_fact_2: You open a vault others can back.
card_preview_note: As you write, this is how the horse prints.
wallet_same_note: The connected wallet will trade this vault.
wallet_other_note: Enter the address that will trade. You still sign the open-vault transaction.
receipt_line: {name} is on the card. Vault opened (demo).
see_on_card: See this horse on the card
connect_to_open: Connect wallet to sign this open-vault. No transaction is sent until you approve it.
scratched_note: Scratched — this horse is not taking deposits.
purse_full_note: Purse is at max. This horse is not taking deposits.
in_form_empty: No in-form horses on the card. See the program.
withdraw_lock: Redeem capital and PnL from this horse
need_amount_lock: Enter how much to lock into this horse.
need_amount_redeem: Enter how much NAV to redeem from this horse.
redeem_wallet_note: Redeem returns capital and PnL together. You still sign.
connect_to_read: Connect to read your book. Nothing moves until you sign.
connect_to_sign_withdraw: Connect wallet to sign this redeem. No transaction is sent until you approve it.
need_amount_settle: Enter an amount to deposit or withdraw.
need_shares: Not enough shares to redeem that amount.
watch_only_note: You own this vault. You cannot pull depositor funds.
book_empty_backed: No backed horses in this book.
book_empty_mine: No horses of yours in this book.
